name: Formal language
description: A precisely specified system of signs, assemblies (terms and relations), and syntactic rules for constructing well-formed expressions.

name: Quantifier (universal, existential)
description: The operators for-all and exists that bind a variable in a relation to express universal or existential properties.

name: Axiom scheme of substitution (logic)
description: The logical scheme permitting replacement of a free variable by a term in any well-formed relation, subject to no variable capture.

name: Modus ponens
description: The fundamental rule of inference: from A and A => B, deduce B.

name: Deductive system
description: The formal framework of proofs as finite sequences of relations, each an axiom or derived by rules of inference; a theorem is the final relation.

name: Hilbert epsilon operator (tau-operator)
description: A term-forming operator tau_x(R) selecting an object satisfying relation R if one exists, used to eliminate quantifiers and formalize choice at the logical level.

name: Axiom of the empty set
description: There exists a set having no elements, denoted empty-set.

name: Axiom of pairing
description: For any two objects a, b, there exists a set {a, b} whose only elements are a and b.

name: Axiom scheme of separation (comprehension)
description: For any set A and property P(x), there exists the set {x in A : P(x)} of exactly those elements of A satisfying P.

name: Axiom of union
description: For any set of sets F, there exists a set whose elements are exactly those belonging to at least one member of F.

name: Axiom of infinity
description: There exists a set containing the empty set and closed under the successor operation x -> x u {x}, guaranteeing the existence of an infinite set.

name: Set membership (element-of relation)
description: The primitive binary relation x in A asserting that x is an element of the set A.

name: Subset (inclusion)
description: A subset-of B means every element of A is an element of B, defining the inclusion partial order on sets.

name: Set intersection
description: A cap B = {x : x in A and x in B}, the set of elements common to both A and B.

name: Set union (binary)
description: A cup B = {x : x in A or x in B}, the set of elements belonging to at least one of A, B.

name: Set complement (difference)
description: A \ B = {x in A : x not in B}, the set of elements in A but not in B.

name: Symmetric difference
description: A triangle B = (A \ B) u (B \ A), the set of elements belonging to exactly one of A, B.

name: Ordered pair
description: The object (a, b) defined via Kuratowski encoding such that (a,b) = (c,d) iff a = c and b = d.

name: Cartesian product
description: A x B = {(a, b) : a in A, b in B}, the set of all ordered pairs with first component in A and second in B.

name: Relation (graph of a relation)
description: A subset R of A x B; one writes xRy to mean (x, y) in R.

name: Function (map, mapping)
description: A relation f subset A x B such that for every a in A there exists exactly one b in B with (a, b) in f, written f : A -> B.

name: Injection (one-to-one map)
description: A function f : A -> B such that f(a1) = f(a2) implies a1 = a2.

name: Surjection (onto map)
description: A function f : A -> B such that for every b in B there exists a in A with f(a) = b.

name: Bijection
description: A function that is both injective and surjective, establishing a one-to-one correspondence.

name: Composition of functions
description: Given f : A -> B and g : B -> C, the composite g o f : A -> C defined by (g o f)(a) = g(f(a)).

name: Inverse function
description: For a bijection f : A -> B, the unique function f^{-1} : B -> A satisfying f^{-1} o f = id_A and f o f^{-1} = id_B.

name: Image and preimage
description: For f : A -> B, the direct image f(S) = {f(x) : x in S} and the inverse image f^{-1}(T) = {x in A : f(x) in T}.

name: Restriction and extension of a function
description: The restriction f|_S of f : A -> B to S subset A; an extension of g : S -> B is any f : A -> B with f|_S = g.

name: Family of sets (indexed family)
description: A function i -> A_i from an index set I to a collection of sets, written (A_i)_{i in I}.

name: Generalized union and intersection
description: For a family (A_i)_{i in I}, the union U_{i in I} A_i and intersection cap_{i in I} A_i, generalizing binary operations to arbitrary index sets.

name: Generalized Cartesian product (product of a family)
description: Product_{i in I} A_i, the set of all choice functions on the family, each selecting an element from A_i for every i.

name: Equivalence relation
description: A relation R on a set A that is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive.

name: Equivalence class
description: For an equivalence relation R on A, the class [a] = {x in A : xRa}.

name: Quotient set
description: A/R = {[a] : a in A}, the set of all equivalence classes, with canonical surjection pi : A -> A/R.

name: Canonical decomposition of a map
description: Every function f : A -> B factors uniquely as A -> A/~ -> f(A) -> B (surjection, bijection, inclusion).

name: Partition of a set
description: A family of pairwise disjoint nonempty subsets whose union is A, in canonical bijection with equivalence relations on A.

name: Diagonal of a product
description: Delta_A = {(a, a) : a in A} subset A x A, the graph of the identity function.

name: Projection map
description: The canonical surjections pr_1 : A x B -> A and pr_2 : A x B -> B extracting components of an ordered pair.

name: Preorder (quasi-order)
description: A reflexive and transitive relation, not necessarily antisymmetric; the quotient by the associated equivalence is a partial order.

name: Strict partial order
description: The irreflexive and transitive relation < derived from <= by x < y iff x <= y and x != y.

name: Greatest element and least element
description: In a poset, a greatest (resp. least) element a satisfies x <= a (resp. a <= x) for all x.

name: Supremum and infimum
description: sup S is the least upper bound of S; inf S is the greatest lower bound of S, when they exist.

name: Lattice
description: A poset in which every pair of elements has both a supremum (join) and an infimum (meet).

name: Complete lattice
description: A poset in which every subset has a supremum and an infimum.

name: Directed set
description: A nonempty preordered set in which every finite subset has an upper bound.

name: Increasing (order-preserving) map
description: A function f between posets such that x <= y implies f(x) <= f(y).

name: Order isomorphism
description: A bijection f between posets such that both f and f^{-1} are order-preserving.

name: Chain (totally ordered subset)
description: A subset of a poset that is totally ordered under the induced order.

name: Well-ordered set
description: A totally ordered set in which every nonempty subset has a least element.

name: Hausdorff maximality principle
description: Every partially ordered set contains a maximal chain; equivalent to axiom of choice.

name: Initial segment (section)
description: In a well-ordered set W, the set S_a = {x in W : x < a} of all elements strictly preceding a.

name: Comparability of well-ordered sets
description: Any two well-ordered sets are comparable: one is order-isomorphic to an initial segment of the other.

name: Cantor's theorem
description: For any set A, there is no surjection from A onto P(A); equivalently |A| < |P(A)|.

name: Equipotence (equinumerosity)
description: Two sets are equipotent if there exists a bijection between them.

name: Finite set
description: A set equipotent to some natural number {0, 1, ..., n-1}.

name: Countable set (denumerable)
description: A set equipotent to a subset of the natural numbers; countably infinite if equipotent to N.

name: Disjoint union (coproduct of sets)
description: A disjoint-union B = (A x {0}) u (B x {1}), a union keeping copies distinct even when they overlap.

name: Absorption law for infinite cardinals
description: For an infinite cardinal kappa, kappa + kappa = kappa * kappa = kappa.

name: Mathematical induction
description: If P(0) holds and P(n) => P(n+1), then P(n) holds for all natural numbers n.

name: Arithmetic of natural numbers
description: Addition and multiplication on N defined by recursion, satisfying commutativity, associativity, distributivity.

name: Order on natural numbers
description: The total order on N where m <= n iff m subset n (as sets), making (N, <=) a well-ordered set.

name: Species of structures
description: Bourbaki's formal specification: base sets, auxiliary sets, typification via echelon construction, and an axiom invariant under transport.

name: Echelon construction type
description: A set obtained from base sets by iterated application of power set and Cartesian product, providing the type of a structure.

name: Isomorphism of structures
description: A bijection between base sets of two structures of the same species that transports one structure to the other.

name: Transport of structures
description: Transferring a structure from one set to another via a bijection, preserving all structural axioms.
function_signature: (Structure on A, Bijection A -> B) -> Structure on B

name: Induced structure (substructure)
description: The structure inherited by a subset of the base set, obtained by restricting the structural data.

name: Product structure
description: The structure on a Cartesian product obtained by combining the structures on each factor componentwise.

name: Quotient structure
description: The structure induced on a quotient set A/R when the equivalence relation R is compatible with the given structure.

name: Initial structure
description: The coarsest structure on a set making a given family of maps into structured sets into morphisms.

name: Final structure
description: The finest structure on a set making a given family of maps from structured sets into morphisms.

name: Morphism (of a species of structures)
description: A map between base sets that respects the structural data; the precise definition depends on the species.

name: Neighborhood filter
description: The filter V(x) of all neighborhoods of a point x in a topological space, whose properties characterize the topology.

name: Filter
description: A nonempty collection of subsets of a set X, closed under finite intersection and supersets, and not containing the empty set.

name: Filter base (basis of a filter)
description: A nonempty collection of nonempty subsets such that any two members contain a common refinement; it generates a filter.

name: Convergence of a filter
description: A filter F on a topological space converges to x if F is finer than the neighborhood filter of x, i.e., V(x) subset F.

name: Cluster point of a filter
description: A point x such that every neighborhood of x meets every set in the filter.

name: Boundary (frontier) of a set
description: dA = cl(A) cap cl(X \ A), the set of points in the closure of A that are not in its interior.

name: Continuous map
description: A function f : X -> Y between topological spaces such that the preimage of every open set in Y is open in X.

name: Open map and closed map
description: A map sending open (resp. closed) sets to open (resp. closed) sets.

name: Subspace topology (induced topology)
description: The topology on a subset A of X whose open sets are intersections of open sets of X with A.

name: Initial topology
description: The coarsest topology on X making a given family of maps f_i : X -> Y_i continuous, with subbase {f_i^{-1}(U_i)}.

name: Final topology
description: The finest topology on Y making a given family of maps g_i : X_i -> Y continuous.

name: Hausdorff space (T2)
description: A topological space in which any two distinct points have disjoint neighborhoods.

name: T1 space
description: A topological space in which every singleton {x} is closed.

name: Regular space (T3)
description: A T1 space in which each point and disjoint closed set can be separated by disjoint open sets.

name: Completely regular space (Tychonoff, T3.5)
description: A T1 space in which points and disjoint closed sets can be separated by continuous real-valued functions.

name: Limit of a function
description: f(x) -> l as x -> a along a filter means the image filter converges to l, unifying all notions of limit.

name: Net (Moore-Smith sequence)
description: A function from a directed set into a topological space, generalizing sequences.

name: Connected space
description: A topological space that cannot be expressed as the union of two disjoint nonempty open sets.

name: Connected component
description: The maximal connected subset containing a given point; connected components partition the space into closed sets.

name: Locally connected space
description: A space in which every point has a neighborhood base consisting of connected open sets.

name: Second-countable space
description: A topological space possessing a countable base for its topology.

name: First-countable space
description: A topological space in which every point has a countable neighborhood base.

name: Separable space
description: A topological space containing a countable dense subset.

name: Uniform space (uniformity)
description: A set X equipped with a filter on X x X (entourages) containing the diagonal, symmetric, and satisfying the triangle condition.

name: Entourage (surrounding)
description: A member V of the uniformity; V[x] = {y : (x,y) in V} is the V-neighborhood of x.

name: Uniform topology
description: The topology on a uniform space where U is open iff for each x in U there exists entourage V with V[x] subset U.

name: Uniformly continuous map
description: A function f between uniform spaces such that for every entourage W of Y, (f x f)^{-1}(W) is an entourage of X.

name: Cauchy filter
description: A filter on a uniform space such that for every entourage V, there exists F in the filter with F x F subset V.

name: Complete uniform space
description: A uniform space in which every Cauchy filter converges.

name: Completion of a uniform space
description: A complete Hausdorff uniform space X-hat with uniformly continuous dense embedding X -> X-hat, unique up to uniform isomorphism.

name: Uniform isomorphism
description: A bijection f between uniform spaces such that both f and f^{-1} are uniformly continuous.

name: Product uniformity
description: The coarsest uniformity on the product making all projections uniformly continuous.

name: Induced uniformity (subspace uniformity)
description: The uniformity on a subset A induced by restricting entourages to A x A.

name: Minimal Cauchy filter
description: A Cauchy filter minimal among all Cauchy filters, used in the construction of completions.

name: Left uniform structure on a topological group
description: The uniformity on G with entourage base {(x,y) : x^{-1}y in V} where V ranges over identity neighborhoods.

name: Subgroup topology
description: The subspace topology on a subgroup H of a topological group G, making H a topological group.

name: Quotient group topology
description: The quotient topology on G/H for a normal subgroup H, making G/H a topological group and projection open.

name: Closure of a subgroup
description: The closure of a subgroup in a topological group is again a subgroup; the closure of a normal subgroup is normal.

name: Neighborhood base at the identity
description: A topological group's topology is completely determined by a neighborhood base at identity e, since translation is a homeomorphism.

name: Open subgroup theorem
description: Every open subgroup of a topological group is also closed; every subgroup containing an open subgroup is open.

name: Completion of a topological group
description: The Hausdorff completion of a topological group carries a canonical topological group structure.

name: Completeness of R (least upper bound property)
description: Every nonempty subset of R bounded above has a least upper bound (supremum) in R.

name: Archimedean property
description: For any real x > 0 and y, there exists natural n with nx > y; equivalently, Z is unbounded in R.

name: Density of Q in R
description: Between any two distinct real numbers there exists a rational number; Q is dense in R.

name: Order topology on R
description: The topology on R generated by open intervals (a, b), coinciding with the metric topology from |x - y|.

name: Extended real line
description: R-bar = R u {-inf, +inf}, a compact totally ordered space extending R with two points at infinity.

name: Absolute value (on R)
description: The function |x| = max(x, -x) on R, defining the standard metric d(x,y) = |x - y|.

name: Monotone convergence for sequences in R
description: Every bounded monotone sequence in R converges to its supremum (if increasing) or infimum (if decreasing).

name: Right and left limits
description: For a real function, f(a+) = lim_{x->a, x>a} f(x) and f(a-) = lim_{x->a, x<a} f(x).

name: Power function
description: x^alpha = exp(alpha ln x) for x > 0, extending integer powers to arbitrary real exponents.

name: Euclidean topology on R^n
description: The product topology on R^n, equivalently the metric topology from the Euclidean norm.

name: Normed vector space (over R)
description: A real vector space equipped with a norm satisfying positive definiteness, homogeneity, and the triangle inequality.

name: Metric uniformity
description: The uniformity on a metric space with entourage base {(x,y) : d(x,y) < epsilon} for epsilon > 0.

name: Equivalent norms on finite-dimensional spaces
description: On a finite-dimensional real vector space, all norms are equivalent, inducing the same topology.

name: Projective limit (inverse limit)
description: For a directed inverse system with connecting morphisms, the subspace of the product consisting of compatible threads.

name: Inductive limit (direct limit)
description: For a directed system with connecting morphisms, the quotient of the disjoint union identifying elements related by morphisms.

name: Solenoid
description: The projective limit of the inverse system ... -> S^1 ->^{xn} S^1, a compact connected abelian group not locally connected.

name: Profinite group
description: A topological group that is a projective limit of finite discrete groups; equivalently, compact totally disconnected Hausdorff.

name: Quasi-compact space
description: A topological space (not necessarily Hausdorff) in which every open cover has a finite subcover; Bourbaki reserves 'compact' for Hausdorff.

name: Finite intersection property characterization of compactness
description: A space is compact iff every collection of closed sets with the finite intersection property has nonempty intersection.

name: Continuous image of compact is compact
description: The continuous image of a compact space is compact.

name: Closed subsets of compact spaces are compact
description: Every closed subset of a compact space is compact; every compact subset of a Hausdorff space is closed.

name: Compact Hausdorff implies normal
description: Every compact Hausdorff space is normal (T4).

name: Continuous bijection from compact to Hausdorff is homeomorphism
description: A continuous bijection from a compact space to a Hausdorff space is automatically a homeomorphism.

name: Proper map
description: A continuous map f : X -> Y such that preimages of compact sets are compact (equivalently, f x id_Z is closed for every Z).

name: Locally finite family
description: A family of subsets such that every point has a neighborhood meeting only finitely many members.

name: Refinement of a cover
description: A cover {V_j} refines {U_i} if every V_j is contained in some U_i.

name: Paracompactness of metrizable spaces (Stone's theorem)
description: Every metrizable space is paracompact; every open cover has a sigma-discrete open refinement.

name: Nowhere dense set
description: A set whose closure has empty interior.

name: Meager set (first category)
description: A countable union of nowhere dense sets; by Baire's theorem, a complete metric space is not meager in itself.

name: Characterization of semicontinuity via liminf/limsup
description: f is lower semicontinuous at x iff f(x) <= lim inf_{y->x} f(y); upper iff f(x) >= lim sup_{y->x} f(y).

name: Supremum of lower semicontinuous functions
description: The pointwise supremum of any family of lower semicontinuous functions is lower semicontinuous.

name: Paracompactness and partitions of unity
description: A Hausdorff space is paracompact iff every open cover admits a subordinate partition of unity.

name: Lindelof space
description: A topological space in which every open cover has a countable subcover.

name: Second-countable implies Lindelof
description: Every second-countable space is Lindelof, separable, and hereditarily Lindelof.

name: Compact-open topology
description: The topology on C(X,Y) generated by subbasic sets {f : f(K) subset U} where K compact and U open.

name: Topology of uniform convergence
description: The topology on function spaces defined by the uniformity: f and g are V-close if (f(x),g(x)) in V for all x.

name: Topology of compact convergence
description: The topology on C(X,Y) defined by uniform convergence on each compact subset of X.

name: Pointwise convergence topology
description: The topology on Y^X induced by the product topology; convergence means convergence at each point.

name: Evaluation map
description: The map ev : C(X,Y) x X -> Y defined by ev(f,x) = f(x); continuous when C(X,Y) has the compact-open topology and X is locally compact.

name: Exponential law for function spaces
description: For locally compact Hausdorff X, C(X x Y, Z) -> C(Y, C(X,Z)) by currying is a homeomorphism under compact-open topology.

name: Uniform limit of continuous functions is continuous
description: C(X,Y) is closed in Y^X under the topology of uniform convergence when Y is Hausdorff.

name: Completeness of function spaces
description: If Y is a complete uniform space, the space of bounded uniformly continuous functions X -> Y is complete under uniform convergence.

name: Filter generated by a base
description: The unique smallest filter containing a given filter base, consisting of all supersets of members of the base.

name: Finer and coarser topologies
description: Topology T1 is finer than T2 if T2 subset T1; the identity (X,T1) -> (X,T2) is then continuous.

name: Discrete and indiscrete topologies
description: The finest topology (every subset open) and the coarsest topology ({empty, X} only) on a set X.

name: Clopen set
description: A set that is simultaneously open and closed; a space is connected iff its only clopen sets are empty and X.

name: Sigma-compact space
description: A topological space that is a countable union of compact subsets.

name: Cauchy sequence
description: A sequence (x_n) in a metric/uniform space such that for every entourage V, there exists N with (x_m, x_n) in V for all m, n >= N.

name: Pseudometric uniformity
description: A pseudometric (allowing d(x,y)=0 for x != y) generates a uniformity; the associated topology need not be Hausdorff.

name: Continuity via filters
description: A map f : X -> Y is continuous at x iff the image filter of the neighborhood filter of x converges to f(x).

name: Universal property of completion
description: Every uniformly continuous map from X to a complete Hausdorff uniform space extends uniquely through X -> X-hat.

name: Compactness equals complete and totally bounded
description: A uniform space is compact iff it is complete and totally bounded.

name: Lebesgue covering lemma
description: For every open cover of a compact metric space, there exists delta > 0 such that every subset of diameter < delta lies in some member.

name: Topological embedding
description: An injective continuous map f : X -> Y that is a homeomorphism onto its image f(X) with the subspace topology.
